items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: Tony Leonardi. I got him on the gig... The bass player was leaving and I said, “Get this guy from Syracuse, Tony Leonardi.”

ctx.x: No it wasn’t Joe, Joe Farrell was there a while, and then Frank Foster was on the band too. And Bill Chase of course. Great trumpet player. Great players man. Tony Leonardi. I got him on the gig.
